Mailing Services

We prep your mail to USPS specs so it qualifies for the lowest postage rates. Addressing, sorting, barcoding, and delivery to the post office — handled.

How Our Mailing Process Works

Cornerstone preps your mail to USPS specifications so your campaign qualifies for the lowest available postage rates. Mailing services cover everything between a finished mail piece and the recipient's mailbox — addressing, sorting, barcoding, presort, and physical USPS entry. We've been doing it for Hudson Valley businesses since 1998 with 2.3M+ pieces processed through the New Paltz BMEU.

You give us a print-ready file (or we print it in-house). We run your mailing list through NCOA and CASS processing to clean addresses and update moves. Then we inkjet-address each piece, apply IMb barcodes, presort the entire job by ZIP code and carrier route, and package it into USPS trays and sacks. We generate the electronic postage statement and deliver the mailing to the post office. For EDDM jobs, we handle the route paperwork and facing slips too. Processing mail for Hudson Valley organizations since 1998 — in-house, not outsourced.

What's Included

Inkjet Addressing
High-speed addressing directly onto mail pieces or labels
CASS/DPV Verification
Address standardization and deliverability validation against USPS databases
Intelligent Mail Barcode

Mail bundled, trayed, and labeled per USPS specifications
Postal Documentation

Postage Classes We Handle

USPS Marketing Mail (Standard)

The most common class for direct mail campaigns. Minimum 200 pieces or 50 lbs. Lowest rates available through presort and automation. Typical delivery in 3–10 business days.

First-Class Presort

Faster delivery (1–5 business days) with forwarding and return services. Presort discounts reduce the per-piece cost below single-piece rates. Ideal for invoices, statements, and time-sensitive communications.

Non-Profit Marketing Mail

Deeply discounted postage rates for qualified 501(c)(3) organizations. We help non-profits apply for and maintain their USPS non-profit mailing authorization. See our non-profit mailing services for details.

Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM)

No mailing list required — reach every address on selected postal routes. Starting at just $0.247/piece for postage. See our EDDM services for details.

Bring Your Own Pieces

Already have your mail pieces printed? We offer mailing-only services. Deliver your printed pieces to our facility and we'll handle addressing, presorting, postage, and USPS induction. This is popular with organizations that have in-house print capabilities but need postal expertise and presort discounts.

Mailing Permits

USPS requires a mailing permit for presorted and bulk mailings. If your organization doesn't have one, we can mail under our permit or help you obtain your own. We also assist non-profits in applying for the USPS non-profit authorization that unlocks the lowest available postage rates. Visit our mailing permits guide for more information.

Mailing Services FAQ

What postage class saves the most money on bulk mailings?

USPS Marketing Mail (formerly Bulk Mail) with presort processing saves 30–50% compared to First-Class single-piece rates. For nonprofits, the nonprofit Marketing Mail authorization cuts costs even further — to as low as $0.132 per piece.

What is the minimum quantity for bulk mail?

USPS Marketing Mail requires a minimum of 200 pieces or 50 pounds per mailing. EDDM mailings require a minimum of 200 pieces per carrier route selected. First-Class presort has no minimum, but the discount only applies when you hit the required quantity thresholds.

Can I bring my own printed pieces for mailing only?

Yes. We offer mailing-only services. Deliver your printed pieces to our facility in New Paltz and we handle addressing, presorting, postage, and USPS induction. This is popular with organizations that print in-house but need postal expertise and presort discounts.

What does inkjet addressing mean?

Inkjet addressing is the process of printing mailing addresses directly onto a mail piece using a high-speed inkjet printer — no labels required. It is required for most USPS automation discounts and produces a cleaner, more professional appearance than adhesive labels.

How long does mail processing take?

Standard mail processing (addressing, barcoding, presorting, tray preparation, and USPS delivery) typically takes 2–3 business days after print is complete. We coordinate closely with the print schedule so mail prep does not add unnecessary delays.

What is CASS certification and why does it matter?

CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System) is USPS-approved software that verifies every address against the official USPS delivery database. CASS-certified addresses qualify for automation postage discounts. Without CASS certification, mail cannot receive presort rates and may be rejected at the post office.

Do you have your own mailing permit?

Yes. If your organization does not have a USPS mailing permit, you can mail under our permit. We can also help you obtain your own permit for long-term mailing programs. For nonprofits, we assist with the USPS nonprofit mailing authorization process.
